name: Ravemon
main_effect:
[End of Your Turn] By deleting this Digimon that has a digivolution card with [Bird] or [Avian] in any of its traits, at the end of your opponent's next turn, play 1 [Ravemon] from your trash without paying its cost.
[On Deletion] You may play 1 [Falcomon] or [Keenan Crier] from your hand or trash without paying its cost.
